title: ToolDefinition
description: One atomic WebMCP tool generated by F3. Owned by Dev A. Consumed by Dev B (S1 action space, S2 graph nodes) and Dev C (agent tool list, F2/S4 metadata revisions).

tool_id.description: <app>.<name>, globally unique, never changes across revisions.

app.description: Seed app id, e.g. shop, admin, blog.

name.description: Agent-facing tool name. F2/S4 may revise this.

description.description: Agent-facing description. F2/S4 may revise this.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) object with type=object, properties, required, additionalProperties=false. F2/S4 may revise descriptions/enums only, never remove required params.

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema of the handler return value. Field names here drive data-dependency edges in the workflow graph.

kind.description: api = handler calls fetch() against the app's own API; ui = handler drives the DOM (click/type).

code.description: JavaScript async function body, evaluated in page context by the sandbox: `async (input) => { ... return output }`. Must only touch approved endpoints/selectors.

selectors.description: CSS selectors a ui handler relies on (for provenance + S4 fix_selector patches).

risk_level.description: Ordered severity. Drives graph node colouring, policy checks and S2 labels.

ref.description: file:line, CSS selector, aria role/name, HTTP method+path, or test file.

version.description: Bumped when the handler/action changes (F3 regeneration).

metadata_revision.description: Bumped by F2/S4 each time name/description/input_schema text changes. 0 = as generated.

status.description: Set by F1 verify stage. Absent = generated.
